json_flags_note: Each element is a separate argv operand passed to c+ build; never a single shell string.

configs.topic: deterministic generation of valid and malformed JSON documents
configs.ops_kind: 512 seeded fixed-template parses + 512 bounded-grammar generated documents
configs.extra_checks: validity bit, root kind/size, bounded array traversal, INVALID error category, json_free(NULL)

configs.ops_kind: 1024 seeded (member, getter) combinations over one mixed-type document
configs.extra_checks: value correctness on success; INVALID/RANGE category and unchanged out-param on refusal; NULL out/error args; json_view_of(NULL)

configs.topic: seeded builder mutations with write/parse round-trip
configs.extra_checks: per-key shadow-value verification after write/parse; NULL key/value and non-finite double refusal; triple-drop mutator refusal
findings: json_builder::add_* does not copy the key (yyjson mutable add_* borrows it); a reused stack key buffer makes all keys alias the last value. This harness uses program-lifetime key literals; see notes.

configs.topic: repeated parse / view / write / free cycles
configs.extra_checks: root size, typed member/at values, write() buffer re-parse parity, json_free per buffer, triple-drop doc, malformed INVALID refusal

configs.ops_kind: 128 cycles x 8 documented post-drop refusal checks
configs.extra_checks: invalid root/child/member views, all getters refuse with unchanged out-params, write() NULL, triple/quadruple drop inert, builder mutators refuse
skips: f093_precapture_view_after_owner_drop: a json_view captured before owner drop is a dangling borrow by contract; using it is caller UB, and ASan is unavailable on this host
